items.title: Germany's search for a nuclear waste site
items.description: Finland has become the first country with a final storage facility for nuclear waste. Germany is still searching for a site, while some countries have yet to start. Costs are expected to total many billions of euros.

items.title: Bulgarians vote in highly polarized presidential runoff overshadowed by Ukraine war
items.description: Voters in Bulgaria are choosing between two candidates with vastly different views of the war in Ukraine and ties with Russia. The runoff comes after a record-low turnout in the first round.
